priorityList: Cast Living Flame pre-combat to generate initial resources.
Use Dragonrage on cooldown, ensuring the target will live for at least 30 seconds.
Sync combat potions and external buffs like Power Infusion with your Dragonrage window.
Use Tip the Scales while Dragonrage is active, prioritizing Eternity Surge or Fire Breath.
Cast Deep Breath if the Strafing Run buff is about to expire to maintain Scalecommander uptime.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empowerment Level 1 in single-target situations.
Cast Fire Breath at Empowerment Level 1 to maintain its damage over time effect.
Cast Disintegrate as your primary Essence spender when Mass Disintegrate stacks are active.
Cast Disintegrate to spend Essence and Essence Burst procs, chaining the cast when 1 tick remains to avoid clipping.
Cast Living Flame whenever the Burnout proc is active.
Cast Living Flame as your primary filler spell while standing stationary.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler while moving if Disintegrate or Living Flame are unavailable.
Use Hover to allow casting while moving and maintain uptime during mechanics.
Use Quell to interrupt enemy spellcasting whenever necessary.
